dedupe_keys.name: sunass wastewater treatment plant ptar information platform peru

description: Peru's sanitation regulator SUNASS produced this online platform on municipal wastewater treatment plants (PTAR), giving each plant's utility, locality, technology, operation and maintenance, plant status, discharge or reuse authorisation and disposal of wastewater and sludge. Coverage is the plants of Peru's utilities, and the page presents the data as provided by Sunass itself. The results can be filtered and are a free download in Excel format. Caveats: the page does not say how often the data are updated, and it was last changed in December 2023. Simulation uses: a national plant inventory for wastewater capacity and resilience studies. Related records: SUNASS utility benchmarking (data-sunass-peru-utility-benchmarking).
